selection: Choose highest 2024 net basket return only if positive and above equal_weight at the same cost; otherwise cash. Lock before computing 2025.
scope: Fractional equal-weight nonoverlapping five-session basket diagnostic, not an executable portfolio. Cost assumptions 50/75/100 bps include a buffer for delivery fees, DP charges and slippage at roughly INR10000 positions; not exact historical contract notes.
quality: Same 36-stock survivor cohort. Exact benchmark-session alignment; no forward filling. Exclude corporate-action windows from 60-session lookback through exit retrospectively; report selection bias.
untouched_test: Not available in downloaded snapshot. 2025 is development evidence only. No claim of fresh out-of-sample validation.
